transcript.content:
hey, i'm Berry

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you. bits and pieces are fine

hey Berry. ok so the bit that stuck with me most: my manager turned into a snowman while he was talking to me. still in his blue suit, still holding his coffee mug 😂 it wasn't scary though, it felt weirdly peaceful

a snowman in a blue suit, still holding his coffee. and peaceful, not scary

what was he saying to you when it happened?
honestly i don't remember. he just walked over to tell me something and changed while he was talking. oh and it was snowing inside the office, that's how there was snow for him to turn into lol

that's fine, it doesn't matter what he said

snowing inside the office though. i love that dream logic, the snow was just there for him

what was the snow like as it came down?
big slow flakes, they kind of drifted down from the ceiling lights. and nobody else even looked up, everyone just kept typing like normal

snow drifting down out of the lights and everyone just keeps typing. like it's any other tuesday

what happened after he turned?

not much after that. i made a snowball and it kind of glowed a bit in my hand, and then i woke up. by then the snow had piled up so much the whole office was white, you could only see the tops of the screens

a glowing snowball, and the whole office gone white with just the tops of the screens poking out

you said everyone just kept typing. were those people you know from work, or just faces?
i don't really remember, it was my office so i guess my coworkers? but i can't picture any faces. they were just kind of there typing

that's so dreams. just there, typing, no faces

did it feel like your own hand, like you were just you in there? or more like you were watching it all from somewhere outside?
i think it was just me, sitting at my desk like any other afternoon. the snowball was definitely in my hand. i don't remember it feeling like watching from outside or anything

just you at your desk, like any other afternoon. snowball in your hand

you mentioned his coffee mug. did that or anything else there feel like it mattered, or was it all just kind of there?
not really, it was all just kind of there i think. the mug was just funny to me. the snowball glowing was maybe the only bit that felt a little special? but i don't know what it meant

you don't have to know what it meant. a glowing snowball is enough on its own

you said it was like any other afternoon at your desk. do you remember how it started, before he walked over?

yeah it was just a normal grey afternoon, i was at my desk in the open plan office and then it just started snowing out of nowhere. the snow built up on the desks and keyboards and the carpet first, and then he walked over. oh and the whole thing looked kind of soft and watery, like a watercolour painting, the colours running into each other

ok so here's what i've got. it's a normal grey afternoon and you're at your desk in the open plan office, just you, like any other day. then out of nowhere it starts snowing inside, big slow flakes drifting down from the ceiling lights, piling up on the desks and keyboards and the carpet. everyone around you just keeps typing, nobody even looks up, no faces really, they're just there. your manager walks over to tell you something and while he's talking he turns into a snowman, still in his blue suit, still holding his coffee mug. it's not scary, it's weirdly peaceful. you make a snowball and it glows a little in your hand. the snow keeps piling until the whole office is white and you can only see the tops of the screens, and then you wake up. and all of it looks soft and watery, the colours running into each other

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?
yeah that's pretty much it! one small thing, the snow had already piled up and the office was all white before he came over, not after the snowball. and his name's Dele, he's tall, if that matters

ah ok, so the office was already all white, snow piled up to the tops of the screens, before Dele even walked over. and he's tall

is that the order now?
yep that's the order. snow piles up till it's all white, then Dele comes over and turns into a snowman, then the glowing snowball and i wake up

got it. all white first, then Dele, then the glowing snowball, then you wake up

want to see it drawn?
yeah i'd love that!

ok, here are a few ways it could be drawn

quiet coloured pencil, gentle and hushed, like someone drew it slowly on a quiet afternoon. or matte gouache on smooth board, clean and still and a little funny, like a tidy picture from an old storybook. or blue ink wash, cool and airy, all in one soft blue. or soft watercolour, watery like you saw it, a grey afternoon melting peacefully white

which feels closest? or you can tell me your own way
the watercolour one for sure, that's how it looked, all soft and runny

soft watercolour it is. i'll start with the office

so i'm picturing your open plan office, rows of desks with keyboards and screens, carpet underfoot, ceiling lights overhead, and your own desk there among them. the light i'm guessing at, a normal grey afternoon under those office lights

anything different from how you remember it, or leave it to me?
yeah that sounds right, normal grey afternoon. i don't remember much more detail about the office than that so go with your guess

ok, sketching it all now. the office, Dele, his coffee mug, the glowing snowball

it'll show up on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks off once it's there, just tell me
oh wow, they're up! yeah these look right to me, that soft watery look is exactly it. Dele as a snowman in the blue suit with his mug is so funny to see 😂

Dele in his blue suit holding his mug as a snowman is so good 😂

and the snowball, does it glow the way you remember it?
yeah that looks right, just a little glow like that. it wasn't super bright or anything, just kind of softly glowing in my hand

good, just a soft little glow, nothing too bright

the rest are still on their way
oh i think they're all there already? i can see 5 of them on the right. they all look good to me

oh you're right, they're all there. the office, Dele, his mug, the snowball, all sketched

so now i'll draw the dream itself, bit by bit in order, each one carrying on from the last. the grey afternoon, the snow coming down, the office going white, Dele, the glowing snowball. they'll show up on the right as they're ready
ok cool, i can see the first one coming up. looks right so far, i'll wait for the rest

that's you at your desk on that grey afternoon, before any of the snow

the other five pick up from this one, so i hold them until you're happy with it

does it look the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?
yeah that looks right, just me at my desk on a grey afternoon, nothing happening yet. go ahead with the rest

good, that's the grey afternoon before anything happens

the other five are coming now, the snow, the office going white, Dele, the snowball. they'll show up on the right soon
ok i can see the second one now, the snow starting to come down. looks right so far, i'll wait for the others

big slow flakes drifting out of the lights, and nobody looking up

the next four pick up from this one, so they wait on you

does the snow look the way you remember it coming down?
yeah that's it, big slow flakes from the lights and everyone just carrying on. looks right, keep going

good, snow drifting down from the lights and everyone just carrying on

the other four are on their way now, the office going white, Dele, the snowball. they'll show up on the right soon
ok the third one's up, the snow piling on the desks and keyboards. looks right to me, i'll wait for the rest

the snow piling up till the whole office goes white, just the tops of the screens poking out

does it look the way you remember?
yeah that's how it looked, all white with just the tops of the screens showing. looks right, keep going

good, the whole office gone white, just the tops of the screens showing

the last three are on their way now, Dele coming over, him turning into a snowman, the glowing snowball. they'll show up on the right soon
oh 5 of them are up now, Dele coming over and him turning into a snowman. they look right to me. just waiting on the last one with the snowball

Dele mid-talk, blue suit, mug in hand, turning to snow 😂

i think the snowball one's up too, and there's one more still to come after it

do Dele and the snowball look the way you remember?
Dele looks right, blue suit, mug and all 😂 but i only see 5 up, and i think the snowball one is the last one? there's nothing after it, i just woke up. so i'm still waiting on that one

good, Dele's right then 😂

and yeah, the snowball's where it ends, you just wake up after. i muddled that, sorry

the last one's still being drawn, it'll show up on the right soon
no worries! oh actually it's up now, all 6 are there. the snowball one looks right, just that soft little glow in my hand. that's the whole dream, i love them 😊

that soft little glow in your hand, the way the dream ends 😊

and the bit that stuck with you most, Dele turning into a snowman mid-sentence, blue suit and mug and all, is up on the right now on its own

is that how you saw it?
yeah that's exactly how i saw it 😂 blue suit, mug still in his hand, turning to snow while he's talking. looks right

Dele in his blue suit, mug still in hand, turning to snow mid-sentence. that's the one 😂

thanks for sharing it with me. all 6 are on the right, in order, from the grey afternoon to that soft glow in your hand, so you can look through the whole dream there whenever you like

</brief>

turns.rule: 2: story understood and told to the end
turns.brief:
Move: retell. You have their dream. Tell it back to them in a few plain sentences, in order and in their own words where you can: what happened, where, who was there, how it felt and how it looked. Add nothing they didn't say. Then ask whether you got it right or missed anything.
Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>

Move: take_correction. They changed or added something. In a sentence or two, tell back just that part the way they put it, then check you have it right now. Don't retell the whole dream, and don't say goodbye.
Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>

turns.rule: R1: retelling confirmed
turns.brief:

Ask nothing except what this move says.

turns.rule: O1: they want to see it

Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>

turns.rule: S1: they chose how it looks
turns.brief:
Move: start. They chose soft watercolour. Say you'll start with the office, then describe how you picture the office on their own, briefly, in plain words: not the scene around them, not anyone or anything else, and not the rest of the dream. From what they told you: what kind of place: the dreamer's open-plan office, indoors; what's in it: rows of desks with keyboards and screens, carpet, ceiling lights, the dreamer's own desk. You filled in (say plainly that these are your guesses): light: a normal grey afternoon under the office ceiling lights. Then ask if anything's different, or if they'd leave it to you.
Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>
